headline: Goal: Tj's custom Android 10 Go launcher com.tj.launcher (repo tjshea90/Launcher, tablet tb8168p1_bsp, sideloaded, GitHu
summary: Session resumed from active-memory handoff #1. Ran Tj's live OTG-cable session step by step: DuraSpeed not the helper killer; accessibility helper stuck in stale Binding state after the 12:48 first-open crash loop, cleared by one tablet restart; all adb permissions, app-ops, battery whitelist and accessibility verified persisted after restart; notification access impossible on Go; lock number overlay and double-erase lock gesture proven on the real tablet; Tj set custom launcher as default Home himself. Coded v0.7.2 here (KA1 PNG icon + keep-alive default off + crash fuse, CBR1 breaker auto-clear on newer version, UX1 wording), code-reviewed (8 fixed, 2 declined), unit tests green; worker restarted at 22:14 UTC; a second Claude session on another account (branch ccr-0e021d44-iyicti) shipped and recorded v0.7.2 at 23:05 and built v0.7.3 (AC1-AC9: plain unlock always custom, battery-saver guard, Solitaire switch gates pre-arm, card geometry from panel, V5 dim, gesture grace, lock log) now in final gate round 3. Then Tj sent a 7-item message (lock screen, power menu, secret entrances, unlock behavior). This session rebased branch ccr-9ab65fa5-vp812y on main, set tools/MIRROR_MAIN off on this branch only, recorded the items and design notes in TASKS.md, replied to Tj with the mapping, and scheduled a resume for v0.7.4 work.
taskDescription: Goal: Tj's custom Android 10 Go launcher com.tj.launcher (repo tjshea90/Launcher, tablet tb8168p1_bsp, sideloaded, GitHub Actions builds, Claude codes) runs on his real tablet without crashing, looks and functions identical to stock Quickstep, lock-screen gestures and power-menu overlay reliable. keyDecisions: Decision: ACC1 root cause is stale Binding state in accessibility manager from the 12:48 crash loop; fix is a tablet restart — Reason: AMS had no ServiceRecord while Binding set stayed; after restart service bound and logs showed unlock handled; DuraSpeed off changed nothing

Decision: notification access is not a missing permission — Reason: low-RAM Go devices refuse managed services for non-whitelisted packages; allow_listener silently leaves enabled_notification_listeners null; ReturnReset already said so; guide must not offer it

Decision: keep-alive default OFF, PNG transparent small icon, crash fuse takes first RemoteServiceException Bad notification crash (switches only keep-alive off, sets keep_alive_blocked, not counted toward 3-crash breaker), onCreate refuses to repost when rules say no, test knob keep_alive_test_bad_icon only in debuggable builds — Reason: system crashed app 3x in 7s on MediaTek SystemUI, tripped breaker, wiped switches and stranded accessibility

Decision: CBR1 clears only the tripped flag on a newer versionCode and leaves Mode untouched; unreadable version stored as Integer.MAX_VALUE — Reason: new version gets fair try but Tj chooses when to return to custom

Decision: updates need no adb (grants, app-ops, battery whitelist, accessibility enabled, Home choice survive in-place update; only optional speed compile is lost) — Reason: same signing key; documented in research/ADB_COMMANDS.txt

Decision: this session does not touch v0.7.3 gate or release and never pushes to main; branch ccr-9ab65fa5-vp812y is main plus a commit setting tools/MIRROR_MAIN off — Reason: other session on another account is mid-gate; android.yml builds main HEAD; concurrent pushes would contaminate release or reject fast-forwards; at integration merge main, set MIRROR_MAIN on, run gates A and B

Decision: lock-screen power-menu cover must work on any lock screen (cover world = custom mode OR keyguard locked) — Reason: Tj's tablet lock from Quickstep has no cover because mode flips to custom only after helper clean-up

Decision: gesture unlock should resume the last Quickstep app (launch intent without RESET_TASK_IF_NEEDED) instead of stock home, fallback stock home — Reason: Tj asked if minimizing apps is necessary; it is not

Decision: new secret entrances supersede earlier N3a removal because Tj explicitly asked for several toggleable hidden options; no hardware keys, no accelerometer; ProfileSession.goToQuickstep needs no helper — Reason: Solitaire hotspot unreliable (default off, needs Solitaire configured and in front)

failedApproaches: Approach: DuraSpeed off to keep shell helper alive → Result: helper dead after 27 minutes anyway → Lesson: killer unknown; treat helper as ephemeral, prefer one-shot batch (BATCH1) or no helper

Approach: unix and TCP sockets between launcher and shell helper → Result: SELinux Permission denied and socket EPERM on this ROM → Lesson: no socket channel; file mailbox has no authentication (sdcard owner uid derived from folder), so BATCH1 one-shot proposed instead

Approach: grant notification access with cmd notification allow_listener → Result: enabled_notification_listeners stayed null (my audit wrongly listed it as missing) → Lesson: Go device refuses it; read ReturnReset comments before claiming a missing permission

Approach: Solitaire hidden hotspot as the way into Quickstep from custom → Result: Tj reports it does not work → Lesson: it is default OFF and needs Solitaire target app configured and in front; replace with independent entrances
Approach: run local rm -rf with variables in a test command → Result: PreToolUse hook blocked it → Lesson: use mktemp and fresh dirs, never work around hooks
Approach: wait for fresh logcat evidence of events minutes later → Result: tablet log buffer holds only about 3 minutes → Lesson: read logs immediately after an event; consider larger buffer
blockers: No hard blocker. Risks: two Claude sessions on one repo (other account owns v0.7.3 gate and release; do not dispatch android.yml for v0.7.3 here); shell helper unreachable and short-lived on the tablet; everything real-device (power-menu card/patch, gestures, entrances) needs Tj's eyes after install; Android emulator SystemUI never crashes on a bad icon so the keep-alive fuse proof there is conditional.
